podcast.body: Released in 1996, this album featured "Scooby Snacks" and a total of five singles. Its enduring appeal was marked by a 20th-anniversary edition released in 2016, highlighting its lasting legacy within the band's discography. "You'll find that on a record entitled Come Find Yourself, which actually featured five singles."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Great Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of the 90s: Part 1

podcast.body: The debut album by Fun Lovin' Criminals, released in the summer of 1996. The album's third single, "Scooby Snacks," became their only hit in North America, but the album itself contributed to their major success in Britain, where they achieved two platinum albums and one gold album, along with two gold compilation albums. "In the summer of 1996, they released their debut album Come Find Yourself."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
